inventory.source: Colorado OIT NHD Waterbodies layer (USGS NHDPlus)
inventory.counties_source: Colorado Census Counties (US Census TIGER via Colorado OIT GIS)
inventory.license: USGS-authored NHD is public domain. Colorado GIS services attribution required.

elevation.methodology: Centroid coordinates were batched to the OpenTopoData ned10m endpoint, which samples USGS National Elevation Dataset 10 m (3DEP). Points that failed NED were retried against ASTER GDEM 30 m. Values are DEM samples at the polygon centroid, not surveyed water-surface elevations.

weather.methodology: Each waterbody is assigned to the 0.25° grid cell containing its centroid. Weather is retrieved once per cell from Open-Meteo, which downscales public forecast/reanalysis models. This is gridded meteorology, not a station observation.
weather.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information where ERA5 is used.

satellite.methodology: STAC search for Sentinel-2 L2A scenes over Colorado. Results are scene footprints and cloud metadata. No raw imagery is downloaded. Surface ice percent is not inferred from scene presence.
